init_BaseStrategyModelAgent: create a BaseStrategyModelAgent instance from a config with device, model path, temperature, and top_p settings
get_orders_single_power: get orders for a single power in a Diplomacy game using the strategy model agent
get_orders_many_powers: get orders for multiple powers simultaneously using the strategy model agent forward policy
forward_policy_actions: run the model forward policy to sample actions with temperature and top_p for all powers
can_share_strategy_check: check whether the BaseStrategyModelAgent supports sharing strategy across multiple powers
